description: This source file defines a React component 'ProtectedRoute' that acts as a route guard in a React application. It manages access control based on authentication state using context provided by 'useAuth'. It displays a loading card while verifying the session, redirects to login if not configured or not authenticated, and renders the child components when authenticated.
